name: Amano Nene
source:
One of the older sisters who is a librarian. She loves her brother a lot and can't help but constantly look after him.

Her main hobby is basking in the sun. She likes having picnics more than camping, and during sunny days you can find her laying on a blanket while reading a book outside.

Sexual weakness: Her feet (especially the soles of her feet) are very ticklish.
